rejection_reason: The object JIT kernel slowed by 11.73% versus main in the eight-round series and was slower than the prior head in all eight paired rounds despite removing per-loop instruction overhead. Subsequent ten-round controls reproduced the regression. Compile sampling was not run; code placement is being corrected before final acceptance.

source_identity.manifest_reconstruction: Merge common_source_input_sha256 with each variant's source_input_sha256_overrides. Complete-manifest hash is SHA256 of sorted compact JSON with separators comma and colon.

method.compiler_flags: default; separate runtime cache per variant
method.elapsed_summary: median of 8 process medians; each process has 7 kernel times; all values retained
method.elapsed_process_order: four forward rotations followed by four reversed rotations
method.elapsed_excludes: compilation, startup, printing, and scoped-file I/O
method.instruction_scope: 8 kernel calls including warmup, with native runtime and GC; excludes startup/compiler/timers/printing
method.jit_instruction_markers: actual ORC execution of instrumented equivalent; every preexisting non-initializer raw LLVM function body is equal, but later whole-module optimization can differ
method.aot_instruction_scope: exact timing executable at f.kernel entry/return; fully inlined ordinary control uses markers
method.compile_samples: not run: candidate rejected after elapsed regression
method.timing_limit: descriptive shared-host results; small speedups or regressions do not establish precision

between_phase_harness_update.reason: For four variants, reverse complete blocks of four rotations instead of every other round so eight rounds put every variant in every position twice. Prepared sources, probes and artifacts are unchanged. Defaults now request eight elapsed rounds and four compile rotations. Read-only review also added fresh-row and exact-cardinality assertions to reject accidental timing/compile phase append retries before final measurements began.
